description: This file defines a C++ header for a data buffer module within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes template classes for scoped storage and a cyclic data buffer, with methods for reading and writing data, and manages internal buffer pointers and sizes.

classes.name: ScopedStorage
classes.description: A template class providing scoped storage with fixed block size, managing a buffer array.

classes.name: CyclicDataBuffer
classes.description: A template class extending a buffer to implement a cyclic (ring) buffer with read/write operations.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer array.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer block.

methods.name: Filled
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently filled in the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns the number of free bytes available in the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic buffer is empty.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer into a provided data frame.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer from a provided data frame.
